limits: No credentials or credential endpoint response bodies are captured.
An admitted RunTask alone does not establish runtime credential issuance.
Pending tasks are stopped after approximately 300 seconds; absence of logs does not identify the cause.
Only owned resources are mutated; shared service-linked role and account settings are not modified.

conclusions.finding: Three broad task/* controls obtained their own assumed task-role STS identity with HTTP 200, emitted task/container metadata, exited 0, and reached STOPPED.
Allow task/* plus explicit ArnLike Deny task/??* admitted both RunTask requests, but both tasks stayed PENDING without an identity log stream until manually stopped at 301.206 and 301.149 seconds.
Allow task/* plus explicit ArnLike Deny task/*/* admitted both RunTask requests, but both tasks stayed PENDING without an identity log stream until manually stopped at 321.740 and 321.516 seconds.

unresolved: No deny-variant container was observed RUNNING, no STS identity was obtained, and no natural terminal initialization failure was observed before the observation bound.

The deny variants separate admission from successful runtime vending but do not directly expose runtime SourceArn. Their PENDING outcomes do not prove credential-vending denial or establish concrete/cluster-qualified SourceArn equality.

[INFERENCE] Admission is consistent with the prior literal wildcard-valued task/* context because neither deny predicate matches that literal; runtime nonprogress is consistent with a different context but remains unproven without a native terminal error or successful complementary runtime identity control.

controls.pendingObservationNote: The second task in each pair was observed/stopped about 20 seconds later while the first task STOPPED transition was awaited. Both remain roughly five-minute observations.
